---
name: Performance Issue
about: Report slow load times, high memory usage, or janky animations
title: '[PERF] '
labels: performance
assignees: ''
---

**Device & Browser Details:**
- Device: [e.g. Redmi 9A, iPhone 12, Low-end Laptop]
- OS & Version: [e.g. Android 10, Windows 10]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome Mobile, Firefox]
- Network Condition: [e.g. 2G, 3G, Slow 4G, Offline]

**Area Affected:**
- [ ] Initial Page Load / Cold Start
- [ ] Schedule Generation Calculation Speed
- [ ] Full Plan Rendering (90+ Days)
- [ ] Checkbox Toggle & Sound Playback Latency
- [ ] Offline PWA Caching / Service Worker
- [ ] Memory Consumption over Long Sessions

**Describe the Performance Bottleneck:**
A clear description of what feels sluggish, freezes, or takes too long. Include DevTools profiling traces or lighthouse metrics if available.

**Expected Performance:**
Target latency or smoothness expectation (e.g. sub-50ms checkbox toggle).
